Surprisingly good, I love coming across an unexpected gem, Paper Lily is well worth your time. The art style is simple, almost harmless, and then the horror hits in ways that feel sharp and creepy. …
Absolutely criminal that the devs gave this out away for free. I expected a one hour at most chapter. I got FOUR hours of content. If you love Horror RPGs, give it a try. …
